How Much Should a Small Business Spend on Google Ads?

Setting an advertising budget can be difficult for small businesses. This guide explains how to calculate, test, and scale your Google Ads spend profitably.

Understand Local Cost-Per-Click (CPC) Metrics

Google Ads charges per click. The cost depends on how many competitors are bidding on the same search terms. Local search terms in Rahuri are generally less competitive and lower cost than broad search terms in large metro cities.

Start with a Controlled Local Test Budget

We recommend starting small businesses with a controlled test budget (e.g. 5,000 to 10,000 INR per month). This budget is enough to collect performance data on click costs, search intent, and form conversion rates.

Scale Budget Based on Customer Lifetime Value

Once you verify that your ads are generating qualified leads at a profitable Cost Per Acquisition (CPA), you can scale your budget. Pay attention to overall conversion rates rather than click volume alone.
